Cacao beans (also called cocoa beans) are fruit crops unlocked at experience level 36. They grow on cacao trees and can be harvested four times.

They are used as ingredients in several recipes, and chocolate in particular which takes the longest time to make in the game.

Like all crops, they are stored in the silo.

Harvesting cacao

The first harvest gives two cacao beans, the second one three, and the other two four. After the third harvest the tree wilts.

Tapping on the tree places a sign on it letting other players know the tree needs to be revived. Once it is, a last harvest can be done before the tree dies. A saw is then required to cut it.

Selling cacao

  • Cacao can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 864 coin for 10 fruit.
  • Buying a cacao tree costs 550 coin.
  • Given all 13 cacao are collected during the four harvests, the batch can be sold for 1,123 coin, thus giving a profit of 573 coin per tree.

Boat orders

  • Boat orders ask for 4 to 6 cacao per crate, up to a total of 24 per boat.

Strategy tips

  • Each tree gives a maximum of 13 cacao beans in less than 6 days
  • They are rare enough that selling them at a lower price is not recommended.
  • On a per hour basis, the cacao tree is the least profitable, earning you a mere 3.8 coins per hour.
  • On a per saw basis, the cacao tree is the most profitable under level 100, profiting 583 coins per saw.
  • Cacao beans are very hard to find in the Daily Dirt.
  • Recipes ask for one to three beans so you need to have several extra trees to cover your needs. Extras can also be useful if you have boats with cacao crates.
